1.0.0: Initial release. Read + trigger connector for Fathom (AI Meeting Notetaker): ListMeetings, FindMeetings, GetMeetingSummary, GetMeetingTranscript, ListMeetingTypes, ListTeams, MakeApiCall and the NewMeetingContentReady webhook trigger.
Authentication uses a Fathom API key sent in the X-Api-Key header; keys are created at developers.fathom.ai and are scoped to the user who creates them.
